study type: Retrospective survey within a cohort study
exposure: Pregnancy in women with Limb Girdle Muscular Dystrophy type R9 (LGMDR9)
cohort: The study included 22 women, 18 years or older, with a genetic and clinical diagnosis of LGMDR9, enrolled in the University of Iowa Wellstone dystroglycanopathy natural history study.
finding: Women with LGMDR9 who are considering pregnancy should be aware of a higher likelihood of assisted vaginal delivery, high rates of labor induction, and potential progression of weakness, with many not returning to pre-pregnancy baseline.
mod_finding: The rates of assisted vaginal delivery (35%) and induction of labor (70%) were significantly higher among women with LGMDR9 compared to the national average.
